title: Prove the sharp radial optimum for exact-sum Gaussian rounding whose square is wire swap
body:
## Exact theorem
Every exact-sum error-one Gaussian-pair map whose square is wire swap has forward and bilateral radial supremum at least sqrt(19)-sqrt(13). A global annular-matching bijection attains the bound. The lower bound assumes no phase covariance: the square identity forces a quarter-turn matching, and a36-vertex counting obstruction forces the sharp crossing.

## Verification and limits
The all-map reduction, constructive proof, independent matching checks and separate root arithmetic review pass eight registered commands with controls. The sharp four-cycle has squared norms13/19. Exact sum plus this square identity excludes conjugation-as-inverse; #6778 remains a tensor obstruction. No caller/tape admission, assumption discharge or new kappa.

Reproduce: python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/sharp-order-four-gaussian-rounding

Base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance; retain #6509, #6534 and #6778 credits. Review is disclosed, not human or formal-kernel verification.
